paite: Huan TOUPA Pathian in gamsa abawl tengteng lak ah gul agitlouhpil pen hi. Ama'n numei kiang ah, "Pathian in, 'Huan a singgah himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei chi ahi maw?" achi hi.
heading: Mihing Thumanlouhna
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden?’”

paite: Numei in gul kiang ah, "Chi lou e, huan a singgahte ne thei mah ung,
english: The woman said to the serpent, “Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat,

paite: himahleh huan laizang a singgah pen ahihleh Pathian in, 'Na ne ding uh ahi kei, khoih leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw na si ding uh chi aka, " achi hi.
english: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it, neither shall you touch it, lest you die.’”

paite: Gul in numei kiang ah, "Si zenzen lou e.
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t surely die,

paite: Na nek ni ua pat na mit uh ahong vak dia, asia leh apha thei in Pathian na hong bang ding uh, chih Pathian in thei kilkel ei ve," achi hi.
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

paite: Numei in singgah nek theih ahi chih leh mit hiptak ahi chih leh mi pilsak ding a singgah etlahhuai ahi, chih atheih in agah alou a, aneta hi. Akiang a om apasal leng apia a, aama'n leng aneta hi.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit, and ate; and she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate.

paite: Anih un amit uh ahong vakta a, vuaktang ahih lam uh hong kithei ua; theipi nah khuikhawm in, puan akibawltawm uhi.
english: The eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

paite: TOUPA Pathian, nitaklam ninem a huan a vak thawmging aza ua; Adam leh azi in huan a sing lak ah TOUPA Pathian ana kibuksan uhi.
english: They heard the voice of Yahweh God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in Adam asam a, akiang ah, "Koi a om na hia?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

paite: Ama'n, "Huan ah na thawmging ka za a, vuaktang ka hih ziak in ka lau a; ka na kibuta," achi hi.
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.”

paite: Ama'n, "Vuaktang na hih kua'n hon hilh ahia? Singgah nek louh ding ka chih ne na hita maw?" achi hi.
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

paite: Adam in, "Hon ompih dia na hon . piak numei in singgah hon pia a, ka . neta hi," achi hi.
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I ate.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian in numei kiang ah, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia?" achi hi. Numei in, "Gul in hon zekhem a, ka neta hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian in gul kiang ah, "Hichibang a na hih ziak in ganhing tengteng leh gamsa chiteng lak ah hamsiat na hi tuanse ding a, bokvak in na pai gigeta ding a, na damsung in leivui na neta ding.
heading: Pathian Vaihawmna
english: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. On your belly you shall go, and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

paite: Nang leh numei ka hon kidousak ding a, na suante leh asuante leng ka kidousak lai ding. Huai in na lutang asidupsak ding a, nang akhetul na sidupsak ding," achi hi.
english: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

paite: Numei kiang ah, "Na haksatna leh na naupaina nakpi in ka pungsak ding a; haksatak in tate na nei ding. Huan na lunggulh na pasal a ahi ding a, ama'n na tung ah thu anei ding," achi hi.
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. In pain you will bear children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

paite: Adam kiang ah, "Na zi thu na man a, singgah na ne ding ahi kei, chi a, ka hon thupiak na nek ziak in nang ziak in leitung hamsiat in a-omta. Na damsung teng in gimtak a sem in agah na neta ding.
english: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten of the tree, of which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ cursed is the ground for your sake. In toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.

paite: Ling leh louling neite leng ahon omsak ding a, lei a anteh na neta ding hi.
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

paite: Lei a na kik nawn masiah na mai a kho-ul luang puappuap in an na neta ding. Lei a pan lakkhiak na hi; leivui na hi a, leivui ah na kik nawn ding," achi hi.
english: By the sweat of your face will you eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For you are dust, and to dust you shall return.”

paite: Adam in azi, mihing tengteng' nu ahih ziak in, amin Evi asa hi.
english: The man called his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all living.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in Adam a ding leh azi a ding in savun puanaktual bawlsak in, asilhsak hi.
english: Yahweh God made coats of skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in, "Ngai un, mihing in asia leh apha thei in eite bang ahong hita, tu in akhut ua sawk in hinna singgah lou a ne in, tangtawn in ahing kha ding uh," achi hi.
heading: Huan A Kipan Adam Leh Evi Hawlkhiakna
english: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Pathian in amah alakkhiakna lei let ding in Eden huan a kipan ahawlkheta hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

paite: Mihingte adelhkheta a; hinna sing lampi veng ding in Eden huan suahlam pang ah cherubte leh mei namsau kilek zualzual a-omsakta hi.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed Cherubs at the east of the garden of Eden, and the flame of a sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
